classificationEvidence.officialCataloguePurpose: The official catalogue describes supplementary learning videos on common food-manufacturing accidents and safe work.
classificationEvidence.inference: Classify the four PDF pages as navigation/reference pages, not four standalone prose lessons. This classification does not establish that all audiovisual instruction is redundant or has been reviewed.

publicationEvidence.verifiedFact: Announcement presents the videos as support for foreign workers learning accident prevention.
